text_block_list.text:
During the press conference before the
autumn
Tenno Sho, Фудзи Кисэки wows the
crowd with her
sleight of hand.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Her smile is bright and bold now that
she's no
longer held back by anxiety.
She promises to give
them the most
wondrous, heart-stopping
entertainment.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Her eyes are fixed resolutely on what
she must
do, and she strides into the
race with her head
held high.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
